description: This source file defines an internal class 'GenericFontTable' within the PdfSharp.Fonts.OpenType namespace. The class represents a generic font table used in OpenType fonts, with constructors to initialize from another font table or font face, and a method for deep copying. It is noted as not yet used in the project.
